steps.message: The diff confirms the change is present and minimal. The file is modified. I will now submit the patch.
The patch was submitted successfully. I will now provide the final summary.

The issue in `rich/table.py` was that when a `Table` was initialized with `highlight=True`, any `Column` objects passed directly to the constructor (instead of strings) would not inherit the table's highlighting because their `highlight` property defaulted to `False`. I modified `Table.__init__` to check if a header is a `Column` instance and if the table is highlighted, I explicitly set the column's highlight to `True` if it is currently `False`. This ensures consistent highlighting across all column types when using `Table`.
